scope: Matched old host/ABI, new host + old ABI control (one captureTransport=capture export alias), and new host/ABI on actual Chrome hardware. Identical emitted source and shaders; output ABI unchanged. Known CPU/GPU preparations may prefer packed capture, while unknown/JS choices retain ordinary native capture. Three fresh processes rotate label/mode order; twelve warmups, seven rounds, four calls/round. Setup, first runs and repeated ready-session opens retained separately, never added to warm medians.
